headline: Agent 落地成焦点：安全沙箱、多智能体协作和模型自动选择成热议
bullets: Replit CEO 提出 AI agent 应在组织可控的专用环境中运行，只给任务必需的资源权限。
Garry Tan 称 Capy Captains 让修 issue 的吞吐量一夜提升约 5 倍，多 captain 与子线程协作是关键。
Vercel 的 Rauchg 认为无状态沙箱是错误基准，agent 必须带着工作区（身份、技能、仓库、记忆）才有用。
有 builder 表示 $200 套餐已够用，不必追求无限 token，并认为现在的智能是史上最贵的。
多位 builder 讨论小模型直接操作权重、WebMCP 等新方向，也有人吐槽群聊式多人 AI 体验很差。
sentiment: 整体偏兴奋和务实，对 agent 基础设施与多智能体协作的进展看好，同时对产品体验和成本仍有吐槽。

posts.name: Guillermo Rauch
posts.text:
Stateless sandboxes are the wrong benchmark. Agents are only useful if they have their workspace with them (identity, skills, repos, memories…)

Vercel Sandbox team has been beautifully delivering on their latency & throughput SLOs, while prioritizing reliability and security.

Doing this while shipping clusters in 19 (‼️) global regions, new features every week, and under immense amount of customer demand in the double digit growth percentage per week.
posts.summaryZh: Rauchg 说无状态沙箱是错误基准，agent 必须带着身份、技能、仓库和记忆等工作区；并夸 Vercel Sandbox 团队在延迟、吞吐、可靠性和 19 个区域上做得好。

posts.name: Peter Yang
posts.text:
The best model for writing & editing is held back by its harness.

I just had both ChatGPT and @GeminiApp suggest copy edits for a post that I'm working on.

ChatGPT's suggestions were almost entirely bad but Gemini's suggestions were actually great.

Unfortunately, Antigravity doesn't seem to have working browser use so I basically have to paste all of Gemini's edits back into ChatGPT to make the edits in my browser.

Tweeting this in the hope that Antigravity will get much better much faster.
posts.summaryZh: Peter Yang 说最好的写作模型被工具拖累：Gemini 的修改建议很好，但 Antigravity 浏览器使用不可用，只能把建议粘回 ChatGPT 改。
